purpose: Tracks the IMMOVABLE #1 PRIORITY active mission for the pulse engine. When set, this overrides the normal priority stack and all overnight fallthrough logic. The active mission is the first thing every pulse run checks.
authority_level: operational — set by Michael or reincarnation extraction

key_concepts.name: Active Mission
key_concepts.definition: An IMMOVABLE #1 PRIORITY that overrides the normal pulse priority stack. When set, every pulse run executes the next unfinished action from the mission pipeline before considering any other work.

key_concepts.name: Next Action Index
key_concepts.definition: Pointer to the current action in the mission pipeline. Each pulse run advances this index after completing one action.

key_concepts.name: Completion Criteria
key_concepts.definition: Explicit checklist that must ALL be satisfied for the mission to be marked COMPLETE. Mission remains active until every criterion is met.

key_concepts.name: Deadline Pattern
key_concepts.definition: Active missions often carry a hard deadline set by Michael. Deadline creates urgency scaling — closer deadline = more aggressive execution.

key_concepts.name: Copilot PR Integration
key_concepts.definition: Active missions may include GitHub Copilot PRs as dependencies. L10 AUTO_MERGE_DEFAULT applies — don't ask Michael to merge PRs.

key_concepts.name: Living Reincarnation State Snapshot
key_concepts.definition: Each active mission captures a 3-line reincarnation state: VECTOR (what we're doing), PRINCIPLES (which laws govern), OPEN_RULINGS (what's unresolved).

implementation_notes.when_to_update: Set by reincarnation extraction (POST_EXTRACT) or Michael directive. Cleared when all completion criteria met. Advanced each pulse run.
implementation_notes.format_contract: Must always contain: mission name, deadline (if any), next_action_index, total_actions, completion_criteria, living_reincarnation_state.
implementation_notes.stale_detection: If deadline passed and mission not marked complete → RED alert in cold start boot.
